slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陆景琛没听出来，温以染知道前面是对她说的。

她迅速管理表情，不能慌，不能露馅，陆景琛又不知道她刚才跟周牧野约会。

她往陆景琛怀里钻，“陆少，我有点晕船呢。”

陆景琛搂住她的腰，“那宝贝儿，你先去客舱休息下，洗个澡。我等会儿就来找你。”

“好，记得快点来哦。”温以染拎着那只鳄鱼皮kelly，摇曳生姿地朝客舱走。

进了客舱，温以染松了口气，总算离那个瘟神远一点。

包扔在床上，她脱了吊带裙走进浴室。

热水冲下来的那一刻，她喟叹了一声，觉得自己终于活过来了。

不用装了，可以享受一会儿。

冲完澡，刚关上热水。门锁咔嗒一声。

她转头看到傅临渊走进浴室，抓过墙上挂着的浴袍。

傅临渊眼底不屑。

“装什么？刚不还投怀送抱？”

温以染心里一抽，你他妈自个儿发情，反给她倒打一耙。

“勾了几个？”傅临渊眸色微沉。

温以染眼神无辜得像只小白兔，“傅先生说的我听不懂。”

傅临渊看她那样子，眼神一暗，“勾男人得有点真本事才行。”

他抓住她的手腕。

“要不我教教你？”

温以染皮笑肉不笑刚想拒绝，傅临渊的声音再度响起。

“景琛如果知道你上过周牧野——”他顿了一下，“你觉得呢？”

温以染没回答。

傅临渊眼神示意，“给我解开。”男人的反应强烈，温以染看到了，但没有动。

她有点儿看不懂了。

眼前这个男人明显是周牧野陆景琛这种富豪圈子里的人，从头到脚都是手工高定。

就算刚刚被她撩起了火，可他想要什么样的女人没有，估计只要勾勾手指头，就有不计其数的女人扑上去。

要她干什么？

他看她的眼神分明像看垃圾，还说她档次低，是路边成衣、地摊货，让她滚。

傅临渊见她不动弹，捏住她的下巴迫使她抬头。

“愣着干嘛，装什么纯？”

温以染下巴生疼，脸上恰到好处露出无辜小百花表情，“傅先生，我是陆少的女朋友，这么做恐怕不太合适吧？”

傅临渊冷笑，“你在乎？”

迎着傅临渊别有深意的眼神，温以染恨不得给他一拳。

压下心口那股恶气，她脸上堆笑，“就算我不在乎，可毕竟是女朋友......”

“别说是女朋友，就算是老婆——”，傅临渊松开手指，扣住她的后颈猛地一翻，将她掼在大理石洗手台上。

“我想上就上。”

周旋过n多男人的她，当然知道下一步将会是什么，甚至该怎么才能让男人感到最大程度的愉悦，她也一清二楚。

但现在，她还有最重要的一步没做。

Page (1/3)

Lu Jingchen didn't hear it, but Wen Yiran knew that he was talking to her.

She quickly managed her expression, not panicking or revealing her secrets. Lu Jingchen didn't know she was dating Zhou Muye just now.

She snuggled into Lu Jingchen's arms, "Mr. Lu, I'm a little seasick."

Lu Jingchen hugged her waist, "Well, honey, you go to the cabin to rest and take a shower. I'll come find you later."

"Okay, remember to come quickly." Wen Yiran carried the crocodile skin Kelly and swayed towards the cabin.

After entering the cabin, Wen Yiran breathed a sigh of relief, finally far away from the god of plague.

Throwing the bag on the bed, she took off her suspender skirt and walked into the bathroom.

The moment the hot water washed down, she sighed, feeling that she was finally alive.

No need to pretend, just enjoy it for a while.

After taking a shower, just turn off the hot water.The door lock clicked.

She turned around and saw Fu Linyuan walking into the bathroom and grabbing the bathrobe hanging on the wall.

Fu Linyuan's eyes were disdainful.

"What are you pretending to be? Didn't you just throw yourself into your arms?"

Wen Yiran's heart twitched, you're in fucking heat yourself, but you're going to beat her up.

"How many have you hooked up?" Fu Linyuan's eyes darkened slightly.

Wen Yiran's eyes were as innocent as a little white rabbit, "I don't understand what Mr. Fu said."

Fu Linyuan's eyes darkened when he saw her like that, "You have to have some real ability to seduce a man."

He grabbed her wrist.

"How about I teach you?"

Wen Yiran smiled but was about to refuse when Fu Linyuan's voice sounded again.

"If Jingchen knew that you had slept with Zhou Muye—" He paused, "What do you think?"

Wen Yiran didn't answer.

Fu Linyuan's eyes signaled, "Untie me." The man's reaction was strong. Wen Yiran saw it, but did not move.

She couldn't understand it.

The man in front of him is obviously someone from the rich circle like Zhou Muye and Lu Jingchen. He is handmade and couture from head to toe.

Even though he was aroused by her just now, there is no woman he wants. It is estimated that as long as he raises his finger, countless women will pounce on him.

What do you want her to do?

He looked at her like she was looking at trash, and told her to get out of here, saying that she was of low quality, a street vendor selling ready-made clothes.

When Fu Linyuan saw that she was motionless, he pinched her chin and forced her to look up.

"Why are you standing there in a daze? Why are you pretending to be innocent?"

Wen Yiran's jaw hurt, and his face showed an innocent expression, "Mr. Fu, I am Mr. Lu's girlfriend. I'm afraid it's not appropriate to do this, right?"

Fu Linyuan sneered, "Do you care?"

Facing Fu Linyuan's thoughtful eyes, Wen Yiran wanted to punch him.

Suppressing the bad breath in her heart, she put a smile on her face, "Even if I don't care, she is my girlfriend after all..."

"Don't say she's a girlfriend, even if she's a wife -" Fu Linyuan loosened his fingers, grabbed the back of her neck and flipped her over, slamming her onto the marble sink.

"I can do it whenever I want."

Having dealt with many men, she certainly knew what the next step would be. She even knew exactly how to make men feel the greatest pleasure.

But now, she still has the most important step to take.
